overview.description: The Corgi Bay Area Based ETF (BAY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in companies headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area in the US. BAY was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
